chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Sindī, from Ṣafwān, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about a man whose family is with him on a journey, and he does not find water: may he approach his wife?
He said: “I do not like that he should do that, unless he is overcome by desire or fears for himself.”

key_terms.مَا أُحِبُّ: I do not approve or prefer
key_terms.يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ: to approach one's wife in marital relations
key_terms.يَخَافَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ: fears harm or difficulty for himself

ai.seo_question: Can a man have marital relations while traveling if no water is available for purification?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on marital relations during travel when water is unavailable. Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام expresses dislike for engaging in it under such circumstances, except where strong sexual desire or fear of harm to oneself creates a need.
